evidenceBoundary.pathNames: selected from the exact parent manifest by bounded Episode 5 and Chapter 1 identity tokens; the exact Episode 5 source, compiled reader, A05C1 source family, opening panel, and opening plate paths must all be present, while the Episode 5 script filename is admitted only through the manifest-selected canonical-script-render classification because its canonical title is not inferred
evidenceBoundary.rule: The recovery tool must verify the exact parent archive, discover one authoritative manifest, verify every emitted file against its manifest byte count and SHA-256, and require every expected Episode 5 and A05C1 path. Missing expected paths or classifications produce source-required status and exit code 3; contradictory custody fails with exit code 2.
